description: A PostHog messaging category: a named group of workflow messages (marketing or transactional) that recipients can opt out of on the preferences page.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the message category belongs to.

Id.description: The message category ID (UUID). Workflow message steps take it as `message_category_id`.

Key.description: Stable identifier for the category, unique within the project, for example `newsletter`. Opt-out lists and preference imports refer to categories by key. Cannot be changed after creation.

Name.description: Display name of the category, shown in the PostHog app.

Description.description: Internal notes about which messages belong to this category. Recipients don't see it.

PublicDescription.description: Description that recipients see next to the category on the preferences page.

CategoryType.description: `marketing` (the PostHog default): recipients can opt out of it, and sends skip recipients who did. `transactional`: for messages a recipient must get, such as receipts or password resets; sends ignore opt-outs and the category doesn't appear on the preferences page.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change.
